method: Offline two-component step and trend classifier with 3-state trend classification: |slope|<0.0018 rejected, |slope|>0.0032 confirmed, else unresolved. Step candidate greatest 13-before/13-after median difference >1.50. Trend median of within-segment bin-median pairwise slopes.

pilot.disclosure: Pilot inspected before freeze; thresholds are pilot-informed; excluded from fresh holdout.

observations: No incorrect decided labels in this synthetic holdout
All four abstentions involve genuine drift plus step with colored noise
Step localization within ±8 for all 200 actual step-bearing traces
Abstentions are withheld decisions, not classified successes
limitations: Threshold bands are heuristic and not confidence intervals with formal coverage guarantees
Noisy synthetic data of predetermined types and known AR1 noise family; not independent real-world validation
Retrospective full-stream evaluation; cannot claim live or causal prediction
This experiment does not verify third-party RH/NS proofs or ROOT0 influence on AI systems
